narrative.overview:
The dashboard is the floor plan of a software factory, read by one owner doing quick checks: look at the lifecycle band to see where every card stands, answer what waits for you, glance at what is running and what it cost, close. It has three views: Factory, Feed and Settings. A card opens in a drawer; a dot on the lifecycle band opens a small peek first.

The surface is a dark page under a faint grain and two soft glows, with translucent panels and hairline borders. Barlow carries words and Barlow Condensed in uppercase carries headings; every number keeps tabular figures. The accent marks money and whatever waits for the owner, and the outcome trio marks results. Color is chosen by the owner: twelve themes change the same tokens and nothing else.
keyCharacteristics: One lifecycle band: every column a cell on a dotted track, every card a dot.
Panels are translucent washes of the theme's ink over the ground, with a hairline border and a 16px radius.
Uppercase condensed headings and uppercase tracked captions; sentence case for prose.
Hairlines instead of shadows at rest; depth appears for the drawer, the peek and the maximized panel.
Two continuous motions only: the cooldown dial and the pulse of a running dot, both stopped under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent appears on money and on what waits for the owner or what the owner is doing. Outcomes use their own trio.

rules.name: The Estimate Rule
rules.body: Every cost is an estimate and says so: "est." next to the figure, or "Spent est." in the header; a missing price shows $ ? with an explanation, never a zero.

rules.name: The Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number keeps tabular figures. Prose stays proportional.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Panels and tiles carry no shadow until something opens over them.

dos: Do take every color from a token, and give every new token a value in every theme.
Do keep captions uppercase and tracked, headings condensed and uppercase, and prose in sentence case.
Do keep numbers in tabular figures and label every cost as an estimate.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and let only what opens cast a shadow.
Do keep the dial and the dot's pulse as the only continuous motion, and give any new motion a reduced-motion fallback.
Do keep factory stage and column names verbatim.
donts: Don't color-code columns or cards; position and name identify a stage.
Don't use the accent as decoration, or the outcome colors for anything but results.
Don't add emoji or icon fonts; text labels carry actions.
Don't link a font or an asset from the network, or add a build step; the dashboard is one self-contained file.
Don't add resting shadows or a third continuous animation.
